I reviewed the candidate plan against the frozen product sources, the replayed contracts, and the checked-out code at `e216294506bed87dd80855937e3fabfbfa322b82`.

**Verified clean:** all 88 `CREATE`/`MODIFY` classifications match the filesystem at HEAD (`src/domain/{body-zones,labels,media,preferences}`, `migration007.ts`, the four new Sqlite repositories are genuinely absent; everything marked `MODIFY` exists). `DatabaseRows` targets the real `types/` path. `migration001`–`006` are correctly `PRESERVE`d, and the plan correctly identifies that `migration002` evaluates `PREDEFINED_CATEGORIES`/`canonicalCategoryKey`/`BODY_ZONES` into its SQL at module load (confirmed: `migration002.ts:1-3`, `migration003.ts:1`, `migration004.ts:1`). `CategoriesScreen` really does carry the N:N session-category relation (`draft.selectedCategoryIds`, `draft.categoryDrafts`). The direct-import scan replay is `MATCH` (40 candidates).

**What fails.** The plan's `CONSUMER_UNAFFECTED` classifications are refuted by the code in four places, and they are not marginal — one of them is the only screen that can create an Exercise:

- `ExerciseScreen.tsx:70-83,173-184` is the sole producer of the `ActivityDefinition` create/update payload. It constructs `ActivityEditorFormValue` and `definitionInput` with `recoverySeconds` and **no `categoryId`**. The plan deletes `recoverySeconds` and makes Catégorie mandatory (`UI-40094921B202-A668499E759A7`), yet leaves this file out of `scope_allow`.
- `ActivityCard.tsx:38` and `ActivitySelectionScreen.tsx:219` read `definition.recoverySeconds` off an `ActivityDefinition`.
- `CompositionScreen.tsx:1603` reads `activity.recoverySeconds` (the occurrence field being replaced) and `:511` writes the autonomous `draft.color` the plan removes.

The i18n criterion is also not atomic: `fr.ts` has **three** distinct `UNILATERAL` value entries (`shared.sideMode.valueLabels` = `""`, `shared.sideMode.tour.valueLabels` = `"–"`, plus two accessibility sets), all pinned by the frozen V2-BILAT-01 decision and by `index.test.ts:370,379-385`. "La traduction française de UNILATERAL est exactement « Aucun »" names none of them.

And the highest-risk preservation in the whole plan — the historical values consumed by `migration002`'s SQL — has no PRESERVE locator at all: `defaults.ts` and `validation.ts` are in `write_scope` as `MODIFY` with only prose protecting them.
